Problem Statement:
Modify time attributes for EUMETSAT AMV products

When loading a FCI AMV NetCDF product witht he `fci_l2_nc` reader the time attributes represent the following:

- `start_time`: start_time of the first image/repeat cycle used for the wind tracking
- `end_time`: start_time of the last image/repeat cycle used for the wind tracking

These are the timestamps stored in the FCI L2 AMV filenames and follows the WMO naming convention. Although it would make sense to have `end_time` representing the **end_time** of the last image used for the wind tracking, it's better to follow the WMO convention and keep it as it is.

However, it would be useful to also make the `wind_time` available. This is a separate dataset available in the AMV product and represented the start_time of the second repeat cycle used to extract the  cloud properties used for cloud detection and height assignment of the winds.

This should ideally be done for all EUMETSAT AMV readers: `fci_l2_nc`, `fci_l2_bufr` and `seviri_l2_bufr`.

Note: revised to be in-line with the latest understanding of the AMV product filename convention.
